hero.subtitle: Noor Al Huda Trading LLC is a UAE-based FMCG company dealing in rice, spices, grains, flour, pulses and oils — sourcing from origin and supplying trusted hospitality and retail brands across the globe.

intro.title: A trusted name in agro commodities since our first shipment.
intro.body: From our headquarters in Dubai, we connect origin farms across India, Pakistan and the wider region with hotels, hospitals, distributors and retailers across the GCC, Asia and beyond. Quality, traceability and on-time delivery are non-negotiable.

about_page.title: A young, dynamic agro-commodity trader from the UAE.
about_page.lead: Noor Al Huda is built around three commitments — superior product, transparent dealing and reliable delivery.
about_page.p1: We are a UAE-headquartered FMCG trading company supplying rice, spices, grains, flour, pulses and oils to hospitality, healthcare and retail clients in the UAE, GCC and beyond.
about_page.p2: Our reputation has been earned in a short span — through hard work, performance excellence and adherence to the highest quality standards. We are geared up to meet the increased demands of today's customers without compromise.
about_page.p3: Today we are proudly supported by a worldwide customer base, growing every day on the strength of our experience, with a single promise: to deliver only premium quality products under our brand.

values.d: Honest weights, honest specs, honest pricing — every shipment, every time.
Inspected at origin, inspected at port, inspected before dispatch.
We grow when our buyers grow. Long-term relationships over single transactions.
From RFQ to quotation in 24 hours; from order to dispatch as fast as the lane allows.

sustainability_page.title: Sourcing responsibly. Trading thoughtfully.
sustainability_page.lead: Our long-term licence to operate depends on the health of the farms we source from, the people we employ and the communities we serve. We are early in this journey — and committed.

pillars.d: Direct relationships with mills and farms; preference for suppliers with documented water and soil-management practices.
Reducing single-use plastic, increasing recycled-content jute and paper sacks for bulk shipments.
Fair wages, safe warehousing and meaningful support for local food-bank initiatives in the UAE.
Lane consolidation, route optimisation and supplier-emissions tracking on our highest-volume SKUs.
